title: Momoi Airi — One Of The Fans〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Let's see... Rin should be...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(There she is.
I promised her that we'd practice together, but it looks like Shizuku and MEIKO are also with her.)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Hello, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why do you look so happy...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. No reason♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it doesn't look like no reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember how you went over to watch Shizuku practice the other day?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shizuku just happened to overhear me telling Rin about what happened...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to eavesdrop on their conversation...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
We told Shizuku about all the wonderful things you said about her, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a big problem!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It made me very happy to hear you said you believed in me, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That isn't exclusive to just me...
We all knew how hard you were working.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I had no idea that you felt that way about me. That made me so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, settle down.
All I did was say what was on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, and you even said I sent shivers down your spine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?! MEIKO, just how much did you tell her?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sorry!
She used her puppy-dog eyes on me...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nobody can say no to her when she does. You know that, right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Urgh... Yeah, I unfortunately do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I'd be over the moon too if Airi showered me with that kind of praise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You gave me some very kind words when you came over to give me those rice balls, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh! What did she say?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stop right there, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's enough! You get to keep that to yourself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, but... I thought you were incredibly cool that time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doesn't matter. That's our little secret!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our little secret. Hehe. Yes, that also works...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That was a close one. If she told them about what I said...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here, these rice balls are for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow... Thank you so much, Airi!
I was just starting to feel a little hungry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did say that you've been practicing all since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you gotta remember to take breaks, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know, but I want to keep going...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I know I still don't have what it takes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I know you're concerned, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. You should do what you feel is right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I would normally try to stop you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're trying to reach a new level, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, you should keep trying until you feel satisfied. And if you feel unsure, I'll be right here watching you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I promise to make this shoot a success.
For MORE MORE JUMP!, and for myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, can you tell us what she told you?! Please!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Saying that it's a secret is only making us more curious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I said no!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, we're here to practice, aren't we?
You two wanted me to teach you that super cute and captivating turn, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Please teach us, Ms. Airi!
